arguments.command:
set -eu
root=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
py=$root/miniconda/bin/python3.12
target=$root/bin/delegate-cagent
tmp=$root/bin/.delegate-cagent.seeded.$$
url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Christopher-Charman/open-webui/e4668f36f6cf8b057c9df22aa3116c57e7605d21/bootstrap-relay/permanent-control/delegate-cagent.py'
cleanup(){ rm -f "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$tmp"
blob=$("$py" - "$tmp" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,sys
b=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
print(hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest())
PY
)
test "$blob" = 'd6c140d9a9c840090748a9ddd2e6ca7cc74defac'
"$py" -m py_compile "$tmp"
chmod 700 "$tmp"
"$tmp" --self-test
mv "$tmp" "$target"
chmod 700 "$target"
trap - EXIT
liveblob=$("$py" - "$target" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,sys
b=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
print(hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest())
PY
)
test "$liveblob" = 'd6c140d9a9c840090748a9ddd2e6ca7cc74defac'
grep -q '^CLAIM_MODEL_SEED = 42$' "$target"
echo LIVE_CAGENT_SEEDED_SOURCE=PASS
echo LIVE_CAGENT_BLOB_SHA=$liveblob
echo CLAIM_MODEL_SEED=42
